Nathan Johnson

Democratic candidate for Attorney General, Texas · Open seat

State senator; litigator and mediator

Texas Senate since 2019 representing part of Dallas County. Won the May 26 runoff with 60.5%.

Where Johnson stands

Federal policy
Promises to challenge Trump administration policies he says harm the Texas economy.
Public integrity
Says he would investigate elected officials regardless of party.
Core services
Would focus the office on child support collection and consumer protection.

Background

  • Texas Senate, District 16, 2019–present
  • Attorney, Thompson Coburn (Dallas)

Also running for Attorney General

  • Mayes Middleton Republican
  • Tom Oxford Libertarian

Sources
